definitions.explanation: The seat part of a toilet that one sits on. In Japan, heated toilet seats (温水洗浄便座) are extremely common.

examples.japanese: {便座|べんざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{便座|べんざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かくて→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちいい→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧。
examples.english: This toilet seat is warm and comfortable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温水|おんすい}→温水：27514_onsui⟧⟦{洗浄|せんじょう}→洗浄：28525_senjou⟧{便座|べんざ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}している→普及する：22182_fukyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: Heated bidet toilet seats are widely used in Japanese homes.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{便|べん}→便：26147_ben⟧ (convenience; toilet) and ⟦{座|ざ}→座：28170_za⟧ (seat). In Japan, advanced toilet seats with heated surfaces, bidet functions, and air dryers are standard in most homes and public restrooms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{温水|おんすい}→温水：27514_onsui⟧⟦{洗浄|せんじょう}→洗浄：28525_senjou⟧{便座|べんざ} — heated bidet toilet seat
- ⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧{便座|べんざ} — heated toilet seat
- {便座|べんざ}⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧ — toilet seat cover
- {便座|べんざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧ — to lower the toilet seat

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan is known worldwide for its high-tech toilet seats. The brand name Washlet (ウォシュレット) has become almost generic for any bidet-equipped toilet seat, similar to how Kleenex is used for tissues in English.
